Profile.lead: Your coach builds your plan from this. Update it whenever something changes.

personal.title: Personal information
personal.text: Height, weight, age and sex give the suggested daily energy intake.

goals.title: Goals

preferences.text: The plan is built around the foods liked and the number of meals a day.

dietary.text: Diet type and allergies flag the recipes that don’t fit.
